goblin.name: Syntax Goblin
goblin.lore: Once a humble data structure, corrupted by Marakathalessa's dark magic. It now prowls the wasteland, causing syntax errors in all who cross its path.

wolf.name: Null Pointer Wolf
wolf.lore: A spectral beast born from dereferenced memory. It hunts those who forget to initialize their variables, leading them into null dimensions.

demon.name: Memory Leak Demon
demon.lore: This creature was once a function - clean, pure, purposeful. But when the Great Compiler fell, it lost its return statement and now wanders forever, never completing.

wraith.name: Segfault Wraith
wraith.lore: The ghost of a crashed program, forever trapped between memory segments. It seeks to drag others into the void of undefined behavior.

compiler.name: Corrupted Compiler
compiler.lore: A shard of the Great Compiler itself, twisted by Marakathalessa's dark magic. It rejects all who dare challenge the corruption of Meridaeia.
